g.text: [Unverified] R4 FROZEN WIP — publication risks human-accepted / reviews NOT READY / cost gate BLOCKED — 2026-10-16
FROZEN WIP — prior specific cases CLOSED
The native engine decides whether each proposed
queue is legal, including proposals from a model.
Pure planning helpers expose calculations but
never import training code into the engine.
The host projects recipient data without
exposing private state or causal traces.
Independent auditors keep their own solvers;
matching verdicts cannot prove complete closure.
legality checks or prove real runtime authority.
Partial wiring supplies no cold-path proof;
neither admission nor learned weights follow.
Proof links track required evidence rather
than imports or deployed runtime dependencies.
and prior results cannot certify changed source.
fresh reviews NOT READY / cost gate BLOCKED
Solid: current manifest dependencies, not deployed calls.
Dotted: browser target or supporting verification, not runtime imports.
Verification obligations remain mandatory; dotted does not waive a gate.
Red: blocked proof obligations; gate node is documentation, not a service.
No app-to-arena/training edge; no core-to-ML dependency; no learned weights.
